verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance documents a built-in AI feature, Compliance Navigator AI™, which provides tailored regulatory guidance. That makes it an in-product AI assistant, but the evidence describes only advisory Q&A, not delegating actions such as filings or record updates to the assistant. The automated annual-report filing is rule-based software automation, not an AI assistant, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence the assistant can take delegated actions inside the product, documentation of its interface and capabilities, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
